findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_trade_documents · Private data: create_trade_documents, search_trade_guides, prepare_shipment, check_transport_document_draft, read_letter_of_credit · Public sink: check_transport_document_draft · Destructive: create_trade_documents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_trade_documents · Private data: create_trade_documents, search_trade_guides, prepare_shipment, check_transport_document_draft, read_letter_of_credit · Public sink: check_transport_document_draft · Destructive: create_trade_documents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
